next.reason: 1985 limits a subscript to integer-1, data-name-2 [{±} integer-2] or index-name-1 [{±} integer-3], with data-name-2 an integer item (SR5) and a signed integer-1 positive (SR6), so a non-integer or negative literal subscript is refused at compile time. §2023:8.4.2.3.2 takes ALL, arithmetic-expression-1, or index-name-1 [{+|-} integer-1]; every 1985 form is still an arithmetic expression or an index form, so 1985 programs keep their meaning. But §2023:8.4.2.3.4 GR1 b) makes a non-integer result a run-time event: "If the evaluation of arithmetic-expression-1 does not result in an integer, the EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT exception condition is set to exist" (PB5008 mode c). ALL is new, allowed only where §2023:8.4.2.3.3 SR6 says ("The subscript ALL may be used only" as an intrinsic-function argument or in a table SORT).
